$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (ori-public-serving Task 1). Seeds the eleven ORI resources decidiq's OriController serves as integriq endpoints under the validation prefix ori-parity/v1, each with an item mapping (OriSerializer's field table) and a list mapping (the ORI envelope), run by two after rules. Anonymous: no authentication rule, with decidiq's AnonRateLimit ceiling of 120 requests a minute per client address (anonymousRateLimit, endpoint 1.3.0, REQ-EP-013), and decidiq's CORS values: its own origin, GET and OPTIONS (cors, endpoint 1.4.0, REQ-EP-014, DECISIONS row 39). The endpoints name decidiq's register and schemas by slug (REQ-EP-011) and gate lists and single objects with one fixedFilters set (REQ-EP-010, REQ-EP-012). Seed objects are created once and never overwrite an administrator's edit. See openspec/changes/ori-public-serving/design.md D1-D4 and Gap 1.

anonymousRateLimit.title: Anonymous rate limit
anonymousRateLimit.description: How many requests one client address may make in a window when no consumer identifies it. Leave it empty and a public endpoint has no limit of its own.

requestsPerWindow.title: Requests per window
requestsPerWindow.description: How many requests one client address may make before it is refused until the window ends.

windowSeconds.title: Window in seconds
windowSeconds.description: How long the window lasts. The count starts again after it.

cors.title: Cross-origin policy
cors.description: Which other websites may call this endpoint from a browser. Leave it empty and any website may call it without credentials.

allowedOrigin.title: Allowed origin
allowedOrigin.description: self for this Nextcloud's own address, * for any website, or one address such as https://www.example.nl.

allowedMethods.title: Allowed methods
allowedMethods.description: The request methods a browser may use. Leave it empty for GET and OPTIONS.

allowedHeaders.title: Allowed headers
allowedHeaders.description: The request headers a browser may send. Leave it empty for Authorization, Content-Type and X-Requested-With.

objects.name: ORI organizations item
objects.description: Projects one decidiq governance-body object onto the ORI Organization fields, the way decidiq's OriSerializer does.

objects.name: ORI organizations list
objects.description: Wraps the projected organizations in the ORI list shape: @context, @type, count and items.

objects.name: ORI organizations item fields
objects.description: Runs the ori-item-organizations mapping over the answer, over each item of a list.

objects.name: ORI organizations list shape
objects.description: On a list answer only, replaces the paging envelope with the ORI list shape.

objects.name: ORI organizations (parity)
objects.description: Serves decidiq's governance-body as the ORI Organization resource, anonymously, under the validation prefix ori-parity. decidiq's own /api/ori/v1/organizations keeps serving until the parity test plan passes.
